name: modal-sandbox
description: Run isolated, reproducible, or resource-controlled tasks in Modal Sandboxes through the modal-sandbox-sdk CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Run reproducible tasks in isolated Modal Sandboxes.
interface.longDescription: Guides agents through safe discovery, authenticated execution, workflow benchmarking, persistent files, and reusable Modal Sandbox workflows using the modal-sandbox-sdk CLI.
defaultPrompt: Run this task in an isolated, reproducible Modal Sandbox.
Benchmark these equivalent workflows under the same sandbox controls.
Use a Modal volume to persist these workspace files.
Start a reusable Modal Sandbox for this coding task.
